acceptance_criterion: The queue lists every event with status Submitted, Under Review, or Awaiting Clarification that has no recorded decision
test_name: drops an event from the queue once it carries a decision

acceptance_criterion: Each row shows event reference, name, proposed date and time, expected attendance, submitting organiser, submission timestamp, and current status
test_name: shows a submitted request with the details a coordinator triages on

acceptance_criterion: The queue is ordered by submission timestamp, oldest first, by default
test_name: orders the queue oldest submission first

acceptance_criterion: Opening a request shows the full submitted content, including accessibility, venue, and equipment requirements
test_name: shows the full submitted content, including requirements

acceptance_criterion: Opening a request with status Submitted changes it to Under Review and records the reviewing coordinator and the timestamp
test_name: moves a Submitted request to Under Review, recording the reviewer and time

acceptance_criterion: If the request is already Under Review by another coordinator, the reviewer on the record is not overwritten
test_name: opening a request twice at once, as from two tabs, records the review once

acceptance_criterion: Requests with status Draft never appear in the queue
test_name: never shows a draft in the queue

acceptance_criterion: Each row shows the submitting organiser
test_name: names the submitting organiser in the review queue

acceptance_criterion: If the request is already Under Review by another coordinator, the name of that coordinator is displayed
test_name: names the coordinator who opened the request first

acceptance_criterion: Opening a request shows the full submitted content, including venue and equipment requirements
test_name: restores saved requirements into the form
